pages.text: How an even mixture paints itself into stripes.

$(thing)Reaction and Diffusion$(): the $(item)Pattern Basin$() holds an activator and an inhibitor. Set how many times faster the inhibitor spreads (the ratio r) and the reaction rate k. Below r of about 5.8 nothing happens; above it stripes and spots form, about 2π·r^¼/√k apart, and that spacing must be inside the recipe's window. A faster reaction is quicker but needs a larger ratio for the same spacing. It makes $(item)Pattern Templates$(); with $(thing)Turing Patterns$(), Turing Morphogens from an Assayed Enzyme, Rational Fields and slime, and with both, Bioculture grows Morphogenic Serum cheaply. Its calibration: complete a symmetric pattern.
